mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than industrial production (INDPRO) over the previous 3 months, it signals a demand-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > INDPRO growth in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tight monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy in strong labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 over the previous month signals strong labor demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is negative for two consecutive quarters.
